description: List retained free audit runs for the store, newest first, with stable run ids, dates and a continuation cursor. Reads only; never starts collection or spends audit allowance.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code, such as GB.

cursor.description: The nextCursor from the previous page; maximum 1,000 characters.

domain.description: The Shopify storefront to check, e.g. example.com. Required until a store is connected; afterwards, omit it to use a connected store.

limit.description: Integer from 1 to 100 runs per page.

store.description: The connected store to use. Omit when only one is connected.

name: list_audit_runs
title: List audit runs
